name: Sonoma County Fish and Wildlife Commission grants

funder.name: Sonoma County Fish and Wildlife Commission

summary: County grants from a fish and wildlife fund for projects that improve fish or wildlife habitat, teach conservation science, or protect and propagate fish and wildlife in Sonoma County, California.
reporting: A final project report is due within 60 days after the project ends; progress reports may be required, and the Commission may inspect the project on site.

geography.quote: California Fish and Wildlife Code Section 13100 requires that funds deposited into the Sonoma County Fish and Wildlife Special Revenue Fund be distributed to deserving projects that benefit fish and wildlife.
